xmldoc.short_description: Create an array of graphics placeholders.

param_input_item.param_description: a nonnegative integer: gives an n-by-n array.
a row vector of nonnegative integers: the size of the array. An empty value gives a 0-by-0 array.
nonnegative integer scalars: the size of each dimension.

description.p: h = gobjects(...) returns an array filled with placeholder graphics objects. It is the graphics counterpart of zeros: use it to preallocate an array that will later receive graphics objects, for example in a loop.
gobjects() returns a 1-by-1 array. The sizes follow the same rules as zeros.
A placeholder is not a valid graphics object: isgraphics and ishandle return false for it. Once real graphics objects are stored in the array, its class changes to the common class of its elements.
A size that is negative or not an integer, or a size argument that is not a row vector, raises the error Nelson:gobjects:invalidDimensions.
